invariants: This is a native Python extension; no equivalent upstream Python package installer is claimed.
Profile-owned directory publication drains a sharing-denied root before mutation and holds a share-delete root handle across the atomic move.
Transient child/root sharing can settle within a fixed one-second publication deadline; unrelated codes or existing destinations fail without replacement.
Cleanup checks sharing access across the existing tree before removing entries; the controlled permanently held directory/file leaves original manifest and complete journal data for later recovery.
All temporary Win32 handles close on success, timeout or failure. The loader uses flags zero rather than requiring the modern DLL-search patch.
Six actual add/upgrade/rollback consumers, two permanent-holder recoveries and error/collision boundaries remain mandatory; an extracted isolated Python 3.8.10 repeats four physical observations.
identity: Profile lease, transaction token, exact file hashes and unchanged manifest retain generation ownership; directory sharing does not change the commit point.
ownership: The active transaction owns staging and journal paths; temporary delete-access root handles close before returning. Foreign destinations are preserved.
ordering: Validate transaction files/profile, acquire scoped mutation ownership, publish the directory atomically, then publish manifest and recover its exact journal.
errors: Only controlled Windows sharing/root-directory rename denial is given a bounded wait; unchanged candidate reruns, warning filters and arbitrary error suppression are not accepted.
cancellation: Synchronous mutation waits are bounded to one second per ownership boundary. Process interruption retains the existing recoverable journal.
adaptation: Native-only Windows filesystem support, independent of upstream bug exceptions. Current real Windows observations are not Win7 certification.
open_questions: The original bc7028c2 external sharing holder is not identified; the same failure mechanism is measured with controlled actual handles.
Arbitrary new external writers between checks, share-delete readers during removal, metadata/ACL changes, power loss and every filesystem failure remain unaccepted.
Full native package ecosystem/ABI/dependencies/trust and deferred Win7 remain separate.
